[P2] Compare earlier observations with the frozen evidence

The retry-order graph and subsequent side-effect progress check examine only `observation_evidence`; cleanup reconciliation excludes those earlier frames. A single earlier snapshot reporting retry count 3 followed by frozen and retirement counts of 2 with `expectedCount=2` therefore produces no finding. Likewise, an earlier reversed retry order is never compared with the frozen order. Include the frozen frame after earlier observations when checking progress, and carry earlier ordering constraints into reconciliation. Add tests where one earlier frame contradicts only the frozen frame.
